Introduction The 5TDM5 series air handler is designed for installation in a closet, utility room, alcove, basement, crawlspace, or attic. These units are specifically designed to pair exclusively with the 5HCL5 Low Profile Heat Pump series. Field installed electric resistance heaters are available.
